# Agentic Zero

> Agentic Zero is a summit on agentic finance for the people building AI agents, financial and payment infrastructure, crypto rails, and autonomous systems.

Agentic Zero's second edition takes place on October 7, 2026, at The Avalon in San Francisco as part of San Francisco Tech Week by a16z.

Agents are already transacting, but today's payment rails were not built for them. Agentic Zero is where agentic finance meets real markets.

The summit on agentic finance lands at San Francisco Tech Week by a16z, bringing together builders of the agentic stack, the systems adapting to it, and the institutions figuring out what comes next.

Current event facts:

- Event: Agentic Zero, second edition
- Date: October 7, 2026
- Context: San Francisco Tech Week by a16z
- Venue: The Avalon, 1244 Sutter Street, San Francisco
- Format: One-day summit
- Focus: AI agents, financial and payment institutions, crypto infrastructure, and autonomous systems
- Tickets: Coming soon; email notifications are available on the official website
- Contact: contact@agenticzero.xyz

First-edition proof:

- Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina
- Attendance: 1,000+ people
- Speakers: 28
- Livestream views: 13k+
- Social media views: 98k+
- Topics included DeFi agents, infrastructure, verifiability, security, agent trust, discovery, autonomous finance, and the agentic stack

Primary audience:

- Founders and AI builders
- Agent infrastructure teams
- Financial and payment infrastructure teams
- Crypto builders and researchers
- Institutional operators working with autonomous systems
- Investors following agentic finance
